# Nova Heritage Group LLC

> Accounting and tax firm in Lee's Summit, Missouri, serving small businesses of every kind and individuals across the Kansas City metro (Missouri and Kansas) and remotely nationwide. Monthly QuickBooks Online bookkeeping, catch-up and cleanup, payroll, sales tax, and business and personal tax preparation with e-filing, at fixed monthly fees. Works with contractors and trades, professional services, retail and e-commerce, real estate investors, new businesses, and individuals. Not a CPA firm; does not perform audits, reviews, compilations, or other attest services.

## Key facts

- Location: Lee's Summit, MO (Kansas City metro). Serves the whole KC metro on both sides of the state line, and clients anywhere in the U.S. remotely.
- Credentials: QuickBooks Online ProAdvisor, Level 2. B.S. Accounting, M.A. Economics.
- Software: QuickBooks Online and QuickBooks Payroll; Xero for clients already on it.
- Clients: any small business (contractors and trades, professional services, retail and e-commerce, real estate investors and landlords, new businesses) plus individuals and families who need personal returns.
- Founder: Greg Novakowski, QuickBooks Online ProAdvisor Level 2, B.S. Accounting, B.A. and M.A. Economics, full-charge bookkeeping and data analytics background.
- Terms: fixed fees, month-to-month, 30 days' notice to cancel. Books closed by the 10th of each month.
- Contact: book a 15-minute fit call at https://calendly.com/novaheritagegroup · greg@novaheritagegroupllc.com · (913) 213-3503

## Pricing (published ranges; exact fee quoted after reviewing the books)

- Essential bookkeeping: $300–350/month
- Professional bookkeeping (most popular): $350–450/month
- Premium bookkeeping (job costing, multiple entities): $450–750/month
- Books + Tax bundle: from $500/month
- Catch-up / cleanup: about 0.75 × monthly rate × months behind, roughly 50% off when a monthly plan starts
- Payroll: +$150–400/month · Sales tax: +$75–150/month
- Business tax return (1120-S, 1065, 1120): from $1,500
- Personal tax return (1040, federal + state): from $250
